Irene / Tom —

Thanks for the packet. I reviewed Charon_MSA_redline_20280503.docx and attached my high-level comments (RWI_MSA_comments_20280505.docx). Summary of the key points from legal: 

- Liability / Cap (Sec 6): The proposed unlimited liability for breach of confidentiality is a material exposure. Suggested compromise: cap general liability to $3M but keep carveouts for willful misconduct and breach of data obligations.
- Data processing / DPA (Schedule B): We can accept most of the redline but need explicit language about subprocessors and SOC2 evidence cadence (annual).
- PO acceptance SLA: 48 hours is aggressive given batching/approval windows; propose 72 hours SLO modeled in the Order Form and allow expedited acknowledgement for critical POs.

If Charon can adjust the unlimited liability ask and accept the SOC2 evidence cadence, we can provide a clean Order Form template with the portal mapping called out. I'm attaching the comment file with line-by-line proposed language.

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Tom / Team —

Following up from Markus' legal comments: I validated the portal fields against both our Ariba and Coupa connectors. I attached a suggested mapping (portal_field_matrix_suggested_mapping.xlsx) with notes per column. Top-level ops notes: 

- Ariba requires vendor_tax_id and company_legal_name as mandatory attributes; we should ensure the Order Form collects those during enrollment.
- Line-level PO SKU: Ariba cXML supports line-level identifiers but many buyers prefer a free-text item description. We recommend mapping both sku_id and description to avoid reconciliation gaps.
- Payment terms / GL: We can accept preferred_payment_terms as an Order Form field; GL code mapping will require a one-time buyer-side mapping table (we can host as a managed mapping).
- PO ack SLA: operationally we can support a 72-hour auto-acknowledgement (matching Markus' proposal) and an expedited 24-hour path for flagged critical POs.

Action items: 
- Tom: share a sample PO XML + the technical API contact so we can test ingest.
- Markus: confirm if you’re comfortable with the 72/24 SLA split so I can bake it into the Order Form template.
- Irene: please schedule the Thurs May 10 alignment — I've proposed 10am PT in the calendar.
